These 25 items are the **paper reporting checklist** (Layer 1). They were
selected from the OpenSkyLab / ASPRS field catalogue using the reporting
audit of 45 studies (main-text Table 8). Items needed to reproduce a
UAV soil-moisture campaign stay here. Catalogue, FAIR-dataset, and full
ASPRS production fields stay in the OpenSkyLab schema (Layer 2) and in
@ASPRS2024 (Layer 3); they are not required in a journal article.
Soil-moisture science fields are the companion module @or-metadata-SM.

| ID | Metadata key | What to report | When | Why this item (n = 45) |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| L1-01 | `spatial_extent` / `site_centroid` | Bounding box or site centroid (WGS84) | Always | Spatial–temporal extent fully reported in 26.7% of studies |
| L1-02 | `temporal_extent` | Acquisition window (ISO 8601, UTC) | Always | Same gap as L1-01; needed for diurnal SM change |
| L1-03 | `start_utc` / `end_utc` | Mission start and end (UTC) | Always | Aligns the overpass with ground sampling |
| L1-04 | `platform_model` | UAV manufacturer and model | Always | Reported in 100% of studies |
| L1-05 | `sensor_type` | RGB, MS, TIR, HS, LiDAR, GNSS-R | Always | Reported in 100% of studies |
| L1-06 | `sensor_model` | Exact payload model | Always | Fully reported in 86.7% |
| L1-07 | `bands` | Band names / centre wavelengths | Optical, MS, HS; NA otherwise | Fully reported in 80.0% |
| L1-08 | `nominal_agl` | Planned altitude (m AGL) | Always | Reported in 100% of studies |
| L1-09 | `gnss_mode` | single / DGNSS / RTK / PPK | Always | Reported in 100% of studies |
| L1-10 | `flight_pattern` | Grid, double-grid, transect, manual | Photogrammetry; NA otherwise | Fully reported in 46.7% |
| L1-11 | `overlap_forward` | Front overlap (%) | Photogrammetry; NA otherwise | Overlap fully reported in 80.0% |
| L1-12 | `overlap_side` | Side overlap (%) | Photogrammetry; NA otherwise | Same as L1-11 |
| L1-13 | `gsd_nominal` | Planned ground sample distance | Always | Reported in 100% of studies |
| L1-14 | `panel_reflectance` | Radiometric method (panel / DLS) | MS / HS; NA otherwise | Fully reported in 64.4% |
| L1-15 | `drift_protocol` | FFC / NUC, FPA temperature, warm-up | TIR; NA otherwise | Fully reported in 17.8% |
| L1-16 | `distortion_model` | Lens model or software default | SfM; NA otherwise | Fully reported in 40.0% |
| L1-17 | `software` | Processing software and version | Always | Fully reported in 91.1% |
| L1-18 | `gcp_survey_method` | GCP survey method, or direct georef | Always (NA = no GCPs) | Fully reported in 93.3% |
| L1-19 | `checkpoint_count` | Number of independent checkpoints *N* | Orthomosaic / DSM; NA otherwise | Report *N*; do not treat ASPRS *N* ≥ 30 as a paper requirement (0% of studies met it) |
| L1-20 | `reported_rmse_horizontal` | Horizontal RMSE if map geometry is claimed | Orthomosaic / DSM; NA otherwise | RMSE_H fully reported in 66.7% |
| L1-21 | `dataset_id` | Dataset DOI or persistent URL | If a dataset is published; else NA | Fully reported in 11.1% — a dataset field, not a paper failure |
| L1-22 | `licence` | SPDX licence | If a dataset is published; else NA | Fully reported in 13.3% |
| L1-23 | `known_issues` | Artefacts, uncorrected drift, cloud shadow | Always | Not scored in the 45-study audit; needed for reuse |
| L1-24 | `weather_source` | On-site weather or nearest station | TIR or optical SM; NA otherwise | Weather fully reported in 62.2% |
| L1-25 | `product_type` | Orthomosaic, DSM, reflectance, LST, SM map | Always | Reported in 100% of studies |

Paper reporting checklist (Layer 1): 25 UAV campaign items retained from the OpenSkyLab / ASPRS catalogue after the 45-study audit.
:::
